# sparsegl

The goal of sparsegl is to fit regularization paths for sparse
group-lasso penalized learning problems. The model is typically fit for
a sequence of regularization parameters $\lambda$. Such estimators
minimize

$$- \ell\left( \beta|y,\ \mathbf{X} \right) + \lambda(1 - \alpha)\sum\limits_{g \in G} \parallel \beta_{g} \parallel_{2} + \lambda\alpha \parallel \beta \parallel_{1}.$$

The main focus of this package is for the case where the loglikelihood
corresponds to Gaussian or logistic regression. But we also provide the
ability to fit arbitrary GLMs using
[`stats::family()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/family.html) objects.
Details may be found in Liang, Cohen, Sólon Heinsfeld, Pestilli, and
McDonald ([2024](#ref-sparsegl)).

## Installation

You can install the released version of sparsegl from
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

``` r
install.packages("sparsegl")
```

You can install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("dajmcdon/sparsegl")
```

## Minimal Example

``` r
set.seed(1010)
n <- 100
p <- 200
X <- matrix(data = rnorm(n * p, mean = 0, sd = 1), nrow = n, ncol = p)
eps <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)
beta_star <- c(
  rep(5, 5), c(5, -5, 2, 0, 0),
  rep(-5, 5), c(2, -3, 8, 0, 0), rep(0, (p - 20))
)
y <- X %*% beta_star + eps
groups <- rep(1:(p / 5), each = 5)
fit1 <- sparsegl(X, y, group = groups)
plot(fit1, y_axis = "coef", x_axis = "penalty", add_legend = FALSE)
```

![](reference/figures/README-minimal-ex-1.svg)

## References

Liang, X., Cohen, A., Sólon Heinsfeld, A., Pestilli, F., and McDonald,
D.J. 2024. “sparsegl: An `R` Package for Estimating Sparse Group Lasso.”
*Journal of Statistical Software* 110(6), 1–23.
<https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v110.i06>.

# Package index

## Estimate sparse group lasso

- [`sparsegl()`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/sparsegl.md)
  : Regularization paths for sparse group-lasso models

- [`cv.sparsegl()`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/cv.sparsegl.md)
  :

  Cross-validation for a `sparsegl` object.

## Methods for sparsegl or cv.sparsegl objects.

- [`plot(`*`<cv.sparsegl>`*`)`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/plot.cv.sparsegl.md)
  :

  Plot cross-validation curves produced from a `cv.sparsegl` object.

- [`plot(`*`<sparsegl>`*`)`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/plot.sparsegl.md)
  :

  Plot solution paths from a `sparsegl` object.

- [`coef(`*`<cv.sparsegl>`*`)`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/coef.cv.sparsegl.md)
  :

  Extract coefficients from a `cv.sparsegl` object.

- [`coef(`*`<sparsegl>`*`)`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/coef.sparsegl.md)
  :

  Extract model coefficients from a `sparsegl` object.

- [`predict(`*`<cv.sparsegl>`*`)`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/predict.cv.sparsegl.md)
  :

  Make predictions from a `cv.sparsegl` object.

- [`predict(`*`<sparsegl>`*`)`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/predict.sparsegl.md)
  :

  Make predictions from a `sparsegl` object.

## Risk estimation

Calculate information criteria for model evaluation and model selection.

- [`estimate_risk()`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/estimate_risk.md)
  : Calculate information criteria.

## Norm calculations

- [`zero_norm()`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/grouped_sp_norm.md)
  [`one_norm()`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/grouped_sp_norm.md)
  [`two_norm()`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/grouped_sp_norm.md)
  [`grouped_zero_norm()`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/grouped_sp_norm.md)
  [`grouped_one_norm()`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/grouped_sp_norm.md)
  [`grouped_two_norm()`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/grouped_sp_norm.md)
  [`grouped_sp_norm()`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/grouped_sp_norm.md)
  [`gr_one_norm()`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/grouped_sp_norm.md)
  [`gr_two_norm()`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/grouped_sp_norm.md)
  [`sp_group_norm()`](https://dajmcdon.github.io/sparsegl/reference/grouped_sp_norm.md)
  : Calculate common norms
